title: Committed host test + cross-impl vectors for the 5.03 backoff payload parser
description: Follow-up from worker6-81a8 codereview: the hand-rolled CBOR scanner lichen_coap_backoff_duration_s (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/backoff.c) currently has zero committed test coverage — the behavioral check was a standalone gcc harness during the round. Add: (1) a host test (extend lichen/tests/coap_client or a tiny standalone dir following lichen/tests/cmake/test_common.cmake) covering: the canonical duty-cycle payload {reason:'duty_cycle', retry_after, level} both orders, retry_after in short form and 2-byte (0x19) form up to the 3600 cap, malformed payloads (non-map, bstr value, negative int, truncated 0x19, long-form keys) all falling back to 60, payload absent -> 60; (2) optionally a shared vector file pinning the exact payload bytes + expected durations for Rust/Python parity (the Python ip_coap and Rust client backoff durations should agree on the same wire 5.03).
